entries.name: California FAIR Plan
entries.service_area_detail: Insurer of last resort for property owners who cannot get coverage in the voluntary market.
entries.notes: Payment Plan Option page: autopay available for eligible policies (must opt in to emailed billing/autopay notices); installment plans. Often paired with a separate 'difference in conditions' policy. Payment-plan page describes Full Pay, 3-pay (40/30/30), 11-pay monthly, $4.50 installment fee (dwelling), 3.5% card fee (ACH free), and autopay enrollment requiring e-billing. Many policyholders pay via broker or mortgage escrow. Autopay for eligible policies requires opting in to emailed billing/autopay notices; no fee for ACH; 3.5% third-party fee for card; $4.50 per installment (triannual/monthly Dwelling Fire and Commercial); $25 returned payment; CEA policies $1 per installment. Guidelines PDF (opened): payments drafted on invoice due date (up to 3 business days); unenroll anytime in the online payment portal under "Update Autopay and Electronic Communications" or via "Unsubscribe" in the emailed notice; to change the notice email you must unenroll and re-enroll. Payment Plan Option page: Full Pay, Triannual (40/30/30) or Monthly (11 installments: 16.67% down + 10 equal payments); dwelling policies on installment plans pay $4.50 per installment and $25 returned-payment fee; third-party fee for card payments; paperless billing and autopay notices available.

entries.name: CalPERS Health - retiree premiums & Complementary Annuitant Premium Program (CAPP)

entries.notes: CAPP invoices are monthly prepay; missing payment cancels coverage until next open enrollment. Payment gateway: one-time payment without login (invoice number) by card or ACH; in myCalPERS one-time or recurring bank payments, payment history, statements, cancel pending/recurring payments. CalPERS Electronic Payment Gateway page: CAPP (Complementary Annuitant Premium Program) health-premium payments can be made one-time without login; in myCalPERS members can set up recurring payments from a bank account and view payment history (My Account > Make a Payment > View All Payment Activity). Most retiree premiums are deducted from the retirement warrant.

entries.name: CalPERS Health Program (retiree health premiums)
entries.service_area_detail: ~1.5M members incl. state and contracting-agency retirees. Retiree share of premium is deducted from the CalPERS retirement warrant; members awaiting retirement/disability approval may use a Direct Payment Authorization (CalPERS-1008) to pay the health plan directly.
entries.mail_payment_address: CalPERS, P.O. Box 942716, Sacramento, CA 94229-2716 (Benefit Services; not a premium lockbox)
entries.senior_programs: Medicare Part B premium reimbursement is added to the retirement check for eligible Medicare-enrolled retirees. CAPP lets annuitants whose allowance is too small to cover premiums keep CalPERS coverage by prepaying.
entries.notes: Most retirees never get a bill: the health premium share is deducted from the monthly CalPERS retirement check, and Plans & Rates (Retiree) shows the monthly amounts. Members waiting for retirement or disability approval can pay their health plan directly using the Direct Payment Authorization form linked from Eligibility & Enrollment. If the retirement check is too small to cover the premium, the CAPP (Complementary Annuitant Premium Program) is a prepay account: invoices are due the 1st and must be received by the 10th of the month before coverage. Pay by mailed check/money order, online in myCalPERS, or monthly EFT drawn on the 5th (set up or stop EFT through myCalPERS or a secure message). Late CAPP payment cancels coverage until the next Open Enrollment. Carrier phone numbers for plan billing questions are on the Plans & Rates page.

SFHSS itself no longer runs AutoPay; recurring payments are set up and stopped in the Payment Portal (instructions PDF on the How to Make a Payment page). Accounts more than 30 days past due are terminated retroactive to the first day of the unpaid coverage period, and you can re-enroll only at the next October Open Enrollment. Monthly COBRA rates are on sfhss.org/monthly-cobra-premium-rates.
